## Demographic characterization

```{r}
metavars <- c("Residence","Age",  "Diet", "Contraceptives", "Regular/daily medication" , "Nicotine") 
metavars2 <- c("Coitus","Alcohol", "Medication during sampling")

metadata <- rio::import('~/Dropbox/Bekzod&Isabella/ME_translation_key/Metadata.xlsx', sheet = 'Samples') %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Residence))
colnames(metadata)[colnames(metadata)=='Nicotin'] <- 'Nicotine'

colnames(MEconc_newlong)[colnames(MEconc_newlong)=='Nicotin'] <- 'Nicotine'
colnames(PBconc_newlong)[colnames(PBconc_newlong)=='Nicotin'] <- 'Nicotine'


colnames(phyX@sam_data)[colnames(phyX@sam_data)=='Nicotin'] <- 'Nicotine'
colnames(phyITS@sam_data)[colnames(phyITS@sam_data)=='Nicotin'] <- 'Nicotine'

dfmeta <- phyX@sam_data %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Participant)) 

hasdata <- full_join(
  data.frame(Sample.name = paste(dfmeta$Participant,dfmeta$cycle,'.',dfmeta$day, sep = ''), 
             has_seq = 1),
  data.frame(Sample.name = paste(MEconc_newlong$Participant,MEconc_newlong$Cycle,'.',MEconc_newlong$`Cycle day`, sep = ''),  has_nmr = 1) %>% filter(!duplicated(Sample.name)),
  by = 'Sample.name') %>% 
  mutate(hasdata = ifelse(has_seq==1 | has_nmr==1,1,0))

dftb1 <- metadata %>% 
  filter(`Blood origen`=='ME') %>% 
  left_join(hasdata, by = c('Sample ID' = 'Sample.name')) %>% 
  group_by(Participant) %>% 
  mutate(n_seq = sum(has_seq, na.rm = T),
         n_NMR = sum(has_nmr, na.rm = T), 
         Coitus_any = (sum(Coitus,na.rm = T)>0) %>% as.numeric(), 
         Alcohol_any = (sum(Alcohol,na.rm = T)>0) %>% as.numeric(), 
         Meds_any = (sum(`Medication during sampling`,na.rm = T)>0) %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  filter(!duplicated(Participant)) %>% 
  mutate(missNMR = ifelse(n_NMR > 6,'>median_nobs','<median_nobs'), 
         missSeq = ifelse(n_seq ==9,'>median_nobs','<median_nobs'))

tb1 <- dftb1 %>% tableone::CreateTableOne(data = ., vars = c(metavars,'n_seq','n_NMR','Coitus_any','Alcohol_any','Meds_any'), factorVars = c(metavars, 'Coitus_any','Alcohol_any','Meds_any'))

tb1missNMR <- dftb1 %>% tableone::CreateTableOne(data = ., 
                                              strata = 'missNMR',
                                              vars = c(metavars,'n_seq','Coitus_any','Alcohol_any','Meds_any'), factorVars = c(metavars, 'Coitus_any','Alcohol_any','Meds_any'))

tb1missSeq <- dftb1 %>% tableone::CreateTableOne(data = ., 
                                              strata = 'missSeq',
                                              vars = c(metavars,'n_NMR','Coitus_any','Alcohol_any','Meds_any'), factorVars = c(metavars, 'Coitus_any','Alcohol_any','Meds_any'))


tab1AMat <- print(tb1, nonnormal = c('n_seq','n_NMR'), printToggle = F) 

tab1AMat_NMR <- print(tb1missNMR, nonnormal = c('n_seq','n_NMR'), printToggle = F) 
tab1AMat_SEQ <- print(tb1missSeq, nonnormal = c('n_seq','n_NMR'), printToggle = F) 


tb12 <- metadata %>% 
  filter(`Blood origen`=='ME') %>% 
  left_join(hasdata, by = c('Sample ID' = 'Sample.name')) %>% 
  filter(hasdata == 1) %>%
  tableone::CreateTableOne(data = ., vars = metavars2, factorVars = metavars2)
tab1BMat <- print(tb12, nonnormal = c('n_seq','n_NMR'), printToggle = F) 

tab1AMat %>% knitr::kable(caption = 'Participant level demographic characterization') 
tab1AMat_NMR %>% knitr::kable(caption = 'Participant level demographic characterization - stratified by number of observed samples with NMR data') 
tab1AMat_SEQ %>% knitr::kable(caption = 'Participant level demographic characterization - stratified by number of observed samples with Sequencing data') 
tab1BMat %>% knitr::kable(caption = 'Sample level demographic characterization')
```

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "Participant")
tab1AMat %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column() %>% 
writeData(wb, "Participant", x = .)
addWorksheet(wb, "Sample")
tab1BMat %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column() %>% 
writeData(wb, "Sample", x = .)

## Betadiversity 

Effect of demographics / meta-information

```{r, eval=FALSE}
metavars <- c("Age", "Residence", "Diet", "Contraceptives", "Regular/daily medication" , "Nicotine", "Coitus", "Alcohol", "Medication during sampling"  )
dfmeta <- MEconc_newlong %>% 
  filter(!duplicated(`Samples #`)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(`Samples #`,Participant,`Cycle day`,metavars) %>% 
  gather(demo,val,-`Samples #`,-Participant,-`Cycle day`)

dfmetaPB <- PBconc_newlong %>% 
  filter(!duplicated(`Samples #`)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(`Samples #`,Participant,metavars) %>% 
  gather(demo,val,-`Samples #`,-Participant)

SCORESdemo <- resDEMO <- data.frame()
nperm <- 999
for (i in  1:length(metavars)){
  # for (i in  1:2){
  # i <- 3
  mvar <- metavars[i]
  mvar2 <- mvar %>% gsub(' ','.',x = .) %>% gsub('/','.',x = .)
  print(mvar2)
  ######## ME-NMR
  dfsel <- dfmeta %>% 
    filter(demo==mvar) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(val)) %>% 
    arrange()
  
  dfselun <- dfsel %>% ungroup %>%  filter(!duplicated(Participant))
  
  df <- MEconc_newlong %>% 
    filter(!is.na(Participant)) %>% 
    filter(`Samples #` %in% dfsel$`Samples #`) %>% 
    filter(!str_detect(met,'PC')) %>% 
    filter(!(str_detect(met,'glycerol') | met == 'ERECTIC' | met=='TSP' | str_detect(met,'PC'))) %>% 
    filter(!(str_detect(met,'glycerol') | str_detect(met,'EDTA') | met == 'ERECTIC' | met=='TSP' )) %>% 
    dplyr::select(`Samples #`, met,logy) %>% 
    spread(met,logy) 
  
  rME <- adonis2(scale(df) ~ factor(`Cycle day`) + val, data=dfsel, permutations=0, method = 'euclidean', by = 'terms') %>% 
    tidy %>% 
    mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-NMR')
  
  rMEperm <- data.frame()
  for (j in 1:nperm){
    dfselperm <- dfsel %>% 
      left_join(dfselun %>% dplyr::select(-`Cycle day`) %>%  mutate(val2 = sample(val)), by = 'Participant')
    rMEperm <- rMEperm %>% 
      bind_rows(adonis2(scale(df) ~ factor(`Cycle day`) + val2, data=dfselperm, 
                        permutations=0, method = 'euclidean', by = 'terms') %>% 
                  tidy %>% filter(term=='val2') %>% 
                  mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-NMR', type = 'perm') )
  }
  
  pv <- sum(rMEperm$statistic>rME$statistic[2]) / dim(rMEperm)[1]
  rME$p.value2 <- NA
  rME$p.value2[2] <- pv
  
  ### vectors for PCA
  mPCA_i <- prcomp(df, scale. = T)
  scrsME <- mPCA_i$x[,1:4] %>% 
    data.frame() %>% 
    mutate(demo = mvar, 
           val = dfsel$val %>% as.character(),
           omics = 'ME-NMR')
  
  
  ######## PB-NMR
  dfsel <- dfmetaPB %>% 
    filter(demo==mvar) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(val)) %>% 
    arrange()
  
  dfselun <- dfsel %>% ungroup %>%  filter(!duplicated(Participant))
  
  if ((dfsel$val %>% unique() %>% length())==1 | dim(dfsel)[1]==0) {
    print(i)
    rPB <- data.frame(term='Model',R2 = NA, p.value = 1) %>% mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'PB-NMR')
  } 
  else {
    
    df <- PBconc_newlong %>% 
      filter(!is.na(Participant)) %>% 
      filter(`Samples #` %in% dfsel$`Samples #`) %>% 
      filter(!str_detect(met,'PC')) %>% 
      filter(!(str_detect(met,'glycerol') | met == 'ERECTIC' | met=='TSP' | str_detect(met,'PC'))) %>% 
      filter(!(str_detect(met,'glycerol') | str_detect(met,'EDTA') | met == 'ERECTIC' | met=='TSP' )) %>% 
      dplyr::select(`Samples #`, met,logy) %>% 
      spread(met,logy) 
    
    rPB <- adonis2(scale(df) ~ val, data=dfsel, permutations=0, method = 'euclidean')  %>% tidy %>% 
      mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'PB-NMR')
    
    rPBperm <- data.frame()
    for (j in 1:nperm){
      dfselperm <- dfsel %>% 
        left_join(dfselun %>% mutate(val2 = sample(val)), by = 'Participant')
      rPBperm <- rPBperm %>% 
        bind_rows(adonis2(scale(df) ~ val2, data=dfselperm, 
                          permutations=0, method = 'euclidean') %>% 
                    tidy %>% filter(term=='Model') %>% 
                    mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-NMR', type = 'perm') )
    }
    
    pv <- sum(rPBperm$statistic>rPB$statistic[1]) / dim(rPBperm)[1]
    rPB$p.value2 <- NA
    rPB$p.value2[1] <- pv
    
    ### vectors for PCA
    mPCA_i <- prcomp(df, scale. = T)
    scrsPB <- mPCA_i$x[,1:4] %>% 
      data.frame() %>% 
      mutate(demo = mvar,
             val = dfsel$val %>% as.character(),
             omics = 'ME-NMR')
  }
  
  # phyX@sam_data$demo <- phyX@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(mvar2)
  
  ####### 16s
  phyXsel <- phyX
  samdf <- data.frame(phyX@sam_data,demo = phyX@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(mvar2) %>% unlist %>% as.vector())
  phyXsel@sam_data <- sample_data(samdf)
  phyXsel <- phyXsel %>% 
    subset_samples(!is.na(demo)) %>% 
    transform_sample_counts( function(x) x  / sum(x)) 
  D16s <- phyXsel %>% phyloseq::distance("bray")
  
  dfsel <- data.frame(sample_data(phyXsel))
  dfselun <- dfsel%>% filter(!duplicated(Participant))
  
  r16s <- adonis2(D16s ~ demo, data = dfsel, permutations = 0) %>% tidy %>% 
    mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-16s')
  
  r16sperm <- data.frame()
  for (j in 1:nperm){
    dfselperm <- dfsel %>% 
      left_join(dfselun %>% mutate(demo2 = sample(demo)), by = 'Participant')
    r16sperm <- r16sperm %>% 
      bind_rows(adonis2(D16s ~ demo2, data = dfselperm, permutations = 0) %>% tidy %>% 
                  mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-16s') %>% filter(term=='Model'))
  }
  
  pv <- sum(r16sperm$statistic>r16s$statistic[1]) / dim(r16sperm)[1]
  r16s$p.value2 <- NA
  r16s$p.value2[1] <- pv
  
  
  ### vectors for PCoA
  NMDS <- monoMDS(D16s, k = 4)
  scrsME16s <- NMDS$points[,1:4] %>% data.frame() 
  colnames(scrsME16s) <- paste('PC',1:4, sep = '')
  scrsME16s <- scrsME16s %>% 
    mutate(demo = mvar, 
           val = dfsel$demo %>% as.character(),
           omics = 'ME-16s')
  
  ##### ITS
  phyXsel <- phyITS
  samdf <- data.frame(phyITS@sam_data,demo = phyITS@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(mvar2) %>% unlist %>% as.vector())
  phyXsel@sam_data <- sample_data(samdf)
  phyXsel <- phyXsel %>% 
    subset_samples(!is.na(demo)) %>% 
    transform_sample_counts( function(x) as.numeric(x>0)) 
  DITS <- phyXsel %>% phyloseq::distance("euclidean")
  
  dfsel <- data.frame(sample_data(phyXsel))
  dfselun <- dfsel%>% filter(!duplicated(Participant))
  
  rITS <- adonis2(DITS ~ demo, data = dfsel, permutations = 0) %>% tidy %>% 
    mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-ITS')
  
  rITSperm <- data.frame()
  for (j in 1:nperm){
    dfselperm <- dfsel %>% 
      left_join(dfselun %>% mutate(demo2 = sample(demo)), by = 'Participant')
    rITSperm <- rITSperm %>% 
      bind_rows(adonis2(DITS ~ demo2, data = dfselperm, permutations = 0) %>% tidy %>% 
                  mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-ITS') %>% filter(term=='Model'))
  }
  
  pv <- sum(rITSperm$statistic>rITS$statistic[1]) / dim(rITSperm)[1]
  rITS$p.value2 <- NA
  rITS$p.value2[1] <- pv
  
  ### vectors for PCoA
  NMDS <- monoMDS(DITS, k = 4)
  scrsMEITS <- NMDS$points[,1:4] %>% data.frame() 
  colnames(scrsMEITS) <- paste('PC',1:4, sep = '')
  
  scrsMEITS <- scrsMEITS %>%
    mutate(demo = mvar, 
           val = dfsel$demo %>% as.character(),
           omics = 'ME-ITS')
  
  phyXsel <- phyITS
  samdf <- data.frame(phyITS@sam_data,demo = phyITS@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(mvar2) %>% unlist %>% as.vector())
  phyXsel@sam_data <- sample_data(samdf)
  phyXsel <- phyXsel %>% 
    subset_samples(!is.na(demo)) %>% 
    transform_sample_counts( function(x) sqrt(x)) 
  DITS <- phyXsel %>% phyloseq::distance("euclidean")
  rITS2 <- adonis2(DITS ~ demo, data = data.frame(sample_data(phyXsel))) %>% 
    tidy %>% 
    mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-ITS-sqrt_counts')
  
  
  resDEMO <- bind_rows(resDEMO,rME,rPB,r16s,rITS,rITS2)
  
  scrs <- bind_rows(scrsME,scrsME16s,scrsMEITS,scrsPB)
  
  SCORESdemo <- bind_rows(SCORESdemo,scrs)
  
}

save(file = 'betademo_res.RData', list = c('SCORESdemo','resDEMO','metavars'))
```

### Robustness of betadiversity associations

We test whether rarefaction and sample-removal causes 16s and ITS results to cause differential results.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
phyXrare2k <- rarefy_even_depth(phyX,2000)
phyXrare10k <- rarefy_even_depth(phyX,10000)
phyITS_100 <- prune_samples(sample_sums(phyITS) >= 100,phyITS)
phyITS_00 <- prune_samples(sample_sums(phyITS) > 0,phyITS)
metavars <- c("Age", "Residence", "Diet", "Contraceptives", "Regular/daily medication" , "Nicotine", "Coitus", "Alcohol", "Medication during sampling"  )

resDEMO_stab <- data.frame()
nperm <- 999
for (i in  1:length(metavars)){
  # for (i in  1:2){
  # i <- 3
  mvar <- metavars[i]
  mvar2 <- mvar %>% gsub(' ','.',x = .) %>% gsub('/','.',x = .)
  print(mvar2)
  
  ####### 16s
  ######Rare 2k
  phyXsel <- phyXrare2k
  samdf <- data.frame(phyXsel@sam_data,demo = phyXsel@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(mvar2) %>% unlist %>% as.vector())
  phyXsel@sam_data <- sample_data(samdf)
  phyXsel <- phyXsel %>% 
    subset_samples(!is.na(demo)) %>% 
    transform_sample_counts( function(x) x  / sum(x)) 
  D16s <- phyXsel %>% phyloseq::distance("bray")
  
  dfsel <- data.frame(sample_data(phyXsel))
  dfselun <- dfsel%>% filter(!duplicated(Participant))
  
  r16s <- adonis2(D16s ~ demo, data = dfsel, permutations = 0) %>% tidy %>% 
    mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-16s')
  
  r16sperm <- data.frame()
  for (j in 1:nperm){
    dfselperm <- dfsel %>% 
      left_join(dfselun %>% mutate(demo2 = sample(demo)), by = 'Participant')
    r16sperm <- r16sperm %>% 
      bind_rows(adonis2(D16s ~ demo2, data = dfselperm, permutations = 0) %>% tidy %>% 
                  mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-16s') %>% filter(term=='Model'))
  }
  
  
  pv <- sum(r16sperm$statistic>r16s$statistic[1]) / dim(r16sperm)[1]
  r16s$p.value2 <- NA
  r16s$p.value2[1] <- pv
  r16srare2k <- r16s
  
  ######Rare 10k
  phyXsel <- phyXrare10k
  samdf <- data.frame(phyXsel@sam_data,demo = phyXsel@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(mvar2) %>% unlist %>% as.vector())
  phyXsel@sam_data <- sample_data(samdf)
  phyXsel <- phyXsel %>% 
    subset_samples(!is.na(demo)) %>% 
    transform_sample_counts( function(x) x  / sum(x)) 
  D16s <- phyXsel %>% phyloseq::distance("bray")
  
  dfsel <- data.frame(sample_data(phyXsel))
  dfselun <- dfsel%>% filter(!duplicated(Participant))
  
  r16s <- adonis2(D16s ~ demo, data = dfsel, permutations = 0) %>% tidy %>% 
    mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-16s')
  
  r16sperm <- data.frame()
  for (j in 1:nperm){
    dfselperm <- dfsel %>% 
      left_join(dfselun %>% mutate(demo2 = sample(demo)), by = 'Participant')
    r16sperm <- r16sperm %>% 
      bind_rows(adonis2(D16s ~ demo2, data = dfselperm, permutations = 0) %>% tidy %>% 
                  mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-16s') %>% filter(term=='Model'))
  }
  
  pv <- sum(r16sperm$statistic>r16s$statistic[1]) / dim(r16sperm)[1]
  r16s$p.value2 <- NA
  r16s$p.value2[1] <- pv
  r16srare10k <- r16s
  
  
  
  ##### ITS - 00reads
  phyXsel <- phyITS_00
  samdf <- data.frame(phyXsel@sam_data,demo = phyXsel@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(mvar2) %>% unlist %>% as.vector())
  phyXsel@sam_data <- sample_data(samdf)
  phyXsel <- phyXsel %>% 
    subset_samples(!is.na(demo)) %>% 
    transform_sample_counts( function(x) as.numeric(x>0)) 
  DITS <- phyXsel %>% phyloseq::distance("euclidean")
  
  dfsel <- data.frame(sample_data(phyXsel))
  dfselun <- dfsel%>% filter(!duplicated(Participant))
  
  rITS <- adonis2(DITS ~ demo, data = dfsel, permutations = 0) %>% tidy %>% 
    mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-ITS')
  
  rITSperm <- data.frame()
  for (j in 1:nperm){
    dfselperm <- dfsel %>% 
      left_join(dfselun %>% mutate(demo2 = sample(demo)), by = 'Participant')
    rITSperm <- rITSperm %>% 
      bind_rows(adonis2(DITS ~ demo2, data = dfselperm, permutations = 0) %>% tidy %>% 
                  mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-ITS') %>% filter(term=='Model'))
  }
  
  pv <- sum(rITSperm$statistic>rITS$statistic[1]) / dim(rITSperm)[1]
  rITS$p.value2 <- NA
  rITS$p.value2[1] <- pv
  rITS_00 <- rITS
  
  
  ##### ITS - 100 reads
  phyXsel <- phyITS_100
  samdf <- data.frame(phyXsel@sam_data,demo = phyXsel@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(mvar2) %>% unlist %>% as.vector())
  phyXsel@sam_data <- sample_data(samdf)
  phyXsel <- phyXsel %>% 
    subset_samples(!is.na(demo)) %>% 
    transform_sample_counts( function(x) as.numeric(x>0)) 
  DITS <- phyXsel %>% phyloseq::distance("euclidean")
  
  dfsel <- data.frame(sample_data(phyXsel))
  dfselun <- dfsel%>% filter(!duplicated(Participant))
  
  rITS <- adonis2(DITS ~ demo, data = dfsel, permutations = 0) %>% tidy %>% 
    mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-ITS')
  
  rITSperm <- data.frame()
  for (j in 1:nperm){
    dfselperm <- dfsel %>% 
      left_join(dfselun %>% mutate(demo2 = sample(demo)), by = 'Participant')
    rITSperm <- rITSperm %>% 
      bind_rows(adonis2(DITS ~ demo2, data = dfselperm, permutations = 0) %>% tidy %>% 
                  mutate(demo = mvar, omics = 'ME-ITS') %>% filter(term=='Model'))
  }
  
  pv <- sum(rITSperm$statistic>rITS$statistic[1]) / dim(rITSperm)[1]
  rITS$p.value2 <- NA
  rITS$p.value2[1] <- pv
  rITS_100 <- rITS
  
  
  
  resDEMO_stab <- bind_rows(resDEMO_stab,
                            r16srare2k %>% mutate(analysis = 'rare2k'),
                            r16srare10k %>% mutate(analysis = 'rare10k'),
                            rITS_00 %>% mutate(analysis = '>0'),
                            rITS_100 %>% mutate(analysis = '>100'))
  
}

save(file = 'betademo_res_stab.RData', list = c('resDEMO_stab','metavars'))
```

### Overall explained variance versus demo 

Figure 4A in publication

```{r}
fmrt <- list(
  R2 = colDef(format = colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 2)),
  p.value2 = colDef(name = 'p-value', format = colFormat(digits = 3))
)

resDEMO %>% 
  filter(term=='Model' | term=='val') %>% 
  filter(!is.na(df)) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(omics,'sqrt')) %>% 
  dplyr::select(demo,omics,df,R2,p.value2) %>% 
  reactable(columns = fmrt) %>% add_subtitle('Overall variance explained (on beta-diversity) by individual demographic information')

resDEMO %>% 
  filter(term=='Model' | term=='val') %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(omics,'sqrt')) %>% 
  rio::export(file = 'Figure4A_data.xlsx')

Fig4A <- resDEMO %>% 
  mutate(pv = myround2(p.value2), 
         pv2 = gtools::stars.pval(p.value2)) %>% 
  filter(term=='Model' | term=='val') %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(omics,'sqrt')) %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(demo,R2, fill = omics, label = pv2)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', position = position_dodge()) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  ylim(c(0,0.16)) +
  geom_text(position = position_dodge(width = 1), hjust = -0.8, vjust = 0.9) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = colorcodes) +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(fill = NULL) + 
  theme(legend.position = 'top') + 
  xlab(NULL)
Fig4A
ggsave(filename = 'FIG4_betadiv.pdf',  plot = Fig4A,width = 6,height = 5.2)
```

####  Statbility of results 

```{r}
resDEMO %>% mutate(analysis = 'original') %>% bind_rows(resDEMO_stab) %>% 
  mutate(pv = myround2(p.value2), 
         pv2 = gtools::stars.pval(p.value2)) %>% 
  filter(term=='Model') %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(omics,'sqrt')) %>%
  filter(omics=='ME-16s' |omics=='ME-ITS') %>%
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(analysis = analysis %>% factor(labels = c('Original','rare10k','rare2k','samples with > 0 reads','samples with > 100 reads'))) %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(demo,R2, fill = analysis, label = pv2)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', position = position_dodge()) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  ylim(c(0,0.16)) +
  geom_text(position = position_dodge(width = 1), hjust = -0.8, vjust = 0.9) + 
  # scale_fill_manual(values = colorcodes) +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(fill = NULL) + 
  theme(legend.position = 'top') + 
  facet_grid(.~omics)
  xlab(NULL)
```

### Examples 

Figure 4B in publication


```{r}
dfsel1 <- MEconc_newlong %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  filter(str_detect(met,'unk29-asparagine') | 
           str_detect(met,'arabinose')) %>% # |
  filter(!is.na(Diet))  %>% 
  dplyr::select(met,Participant,Diet,Cycle,`Cycle day`,logy)

dfsel2 <- MEconc_newlong %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Nicotine)) %>%
  filter(str_detect(met,'trimethylamine')) %>% 
  dplyr::select(met,Participant,Nicotine,Cycle,`Cycle day`,logy)
  
dfsel1 %>% rio::export(file = 'Figure4B1_data.xlsx')
dfsel2 %>% rio::export(file = 'Figure4B2_data.xlsx')

g1 <- MEconc_newlong %>% 
  filter(str_detect(met,'unk29-asparagine') | 
           str_detect(met,'arabinose')) %>% # |
  # str_detect(met,'bin-ornithine-creatinine-tyrosine')) %>% 
  mutate(met = met %>% gsub('unk29-','',x = .) %>% gsub('bin-','',x = .)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Diet)) %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(Diet,logy, fill = Diet)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('red','blue','chartreuse3')) + 
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm() + 
  theme_bw() + 
  # facet_wrap(~met, scales = 'free', ncol = 1) + 
  facet_grid(met~., scales = 'free') + 
  theme(legend.position = 'none')

g1b <- MEconc_newlong %>% 
  mutate(Nicotine = Nicotine %>% factor()) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(met,'trimethylamine')) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Nicotine)) %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(Nicotine,logy, fill = Nicotine)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm() + 
  theme_bw() + 
  # facet_wrap(~met, scales = 'free', ncol = 1) + 
  facet_grid(met~., scales = 'free') + 
  theme(legend.position = 'none')

g2 <- MEconc_newlong %>% 
  filter(str_detect(met,'unk29-asparagine') | 
           str_detect(met,'arabinose')) %>% # |
  mutate(met = met %>% gsub('unk29-','',x = .) %>% gsub('bin-','',x = .)) %>%
  mutate(met = met %>% gsub('unk','',x = .)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Diet)) %>%
  mutate(cycle_day = parse_number(Cycle)*4 + `Cycle day`) %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(cycle_day,logy, group = Participant, color =Diet)) + 
  geom_line() + geom_point() + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(5,6,7,9,10,11,13,14,15),
                     labels =  c('1-1','1-2','1-3','2-1','2-2','2-3','3-1','3-2','3-3')) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c('red','blue','chartreuse3')) + 
  # facet_wrap(~met, scales = 'free', ncol = 1) + 
  facet_grid(met~., scales = 'free') + 
  theme_bw() + 
  xlab('Cycle-Day') + 
  theme(legend.position = 'none',
    strip.text.y       = element_blank(),
    strip.background.y = element_blank()
  )

g2b <- MEconc_newlong %>%
  filter(str_detect(met,'trimethylamine')) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Nicotine)) %>%
  mutate(cycle_day = parse_number(Cycle)*4 + `Cycle day`, 
         Nicotine = Nicotine %>% factor()) %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(cycle_day,logy, group = Participant, color =Nicotine)) + 
  geom_line() + geom_point() + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(5,6,7,9,10,11,13,14,15),
                     labels =  c('1-1','1-2','1-3','2-1','2-2','2-3','3-1','3-2','3-3')) + 
  # facet_wrap(~met, scales = 'free', ncol = 1) + 
  facet_grid(met~., scales = 'free') +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab('Cycle-Day') + 
  theme(legend.position = 'none',
    strip.text.y       = element_blank(),
    strip.background.y = element_blank()
  )

layout <- "
AAAB
AAAB
CCCD
"
FIG2b <- g2 + g1 + g2b + g1b + plot_layout(design = layout , axes = 'collect')
FIG2b
ggsave(filename = 'FIG4_dietexamples.pdf',  plot = FIG2b,width = 5,height = 5)
```

  ggplot(data = ., aes(PC1,PC2, color = val)) + 
  geom_point() +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = val)) + 
  facet_wrap(~demo + omics, scales = 'free', ncol = 3) + 
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom')
